about_short_description.short_description: MovingLake provides a data platform for real-time and event-driven data connectors.

product.name: MovingLake Real-Time API Integration Platform
product.description: A platform providing real-time API connectors to sync data between various enterprise systems and data repositories.

product.name: Ethereum Connector
product.description: A connector that streams real-time Ethereum blockchain data including transactions, contract metadata, and NFT metadata to various data destinations.

product.name: Fols Accor Connector
product.description: An integration connector for the FOLS property management system by AccorHotels, syncing hotel management data to various data repositories.

product.name: RentManager Connector
product.description: A connector that integrates RentManager property management software data, including maintenance, accounting, and reporting, with various data destinations.

product.name: Supercontrol Connector
product.description: A connector for Supercontrol booking management software, syncing booking, payment, channel management, and reporting data to various destinations.

product.name: Vrbo Connector
product.description: A connector that streams reservation, listing, and calendar data from the Vrbo vacation rental marketplace to supported data destinations.
